notes.title: Demo Update 0.3.1
notes.content:
Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where Bow Anvils would change to Sword Anvils when it's reloaded

Fixed an issue where enemies could remain frozen (visually) if killed while under the effect of a Freeze Bomb

Fixed an issue where Freeze Bomb did not work correctly on animals

Fixed an issue where weapons could be transferred to inactive Weapon Slots when moved from a Repair Anvil using the quick transfer option (double clicking on the weapon)

Fixed an issue where sometimes certain weapons cannot be refreshed in any shop tables

Fixed a dungeon room generation issue that caused incorrect tiles to appear along room edges


Improvements
Improved animal behavior

Improved structure loading to prevent placed structures from disappearing when the game loads

notes.title: Demo Update 0.3
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

This update brings some quality of life improvements, dungeon/farming adjustments, and bug fixes. Inventory management is now smoother and easier, dungeon rewards have been adjusted, and farming interactions feel more polished. Here’s what’s new:


Quality of Life
Added an option to quickly move items via double click. Double clicking now transfers items as the follow:

Main Inventory -> Chest

Main Inventory -> Shop Sell

Main Inventory -> Hot Bar

Hot Bar -> Chest

Hot Bar -> Shop

Hot Bar -> Main Inventory

Hot Bar -> Repair

Chest-> Hot Bar (if Hot Bar is full, then the item will be moved to Main Inventory)

Shop -> Hot Bar (if Hot Bar is full, then the item will be moved to Main Inventory)

Repair Anvil -> Weapon Bar

Repair Anvil -> Hot Bar (if Hot Bar is full, then the item will be moved to Main Inventory)

Weapon Bar -> Repair Anvil

Weapon Bar -> Hot Bar (if Hot Bar is full, then the item will be moved to Main Inventory)

Items can now be stacked and swapped between Shop and the inventory


Dungeon
Added a reroll option when selecting buffs

Added Elite Rooms mini map icons, which are now optional (up until Chamber 1-5). In other words, Elite Rooms don't have to be cleared in order to progress to the next stage

Added additional purchasables to Dungeon Shops

Updated dungeon chest rewards

Higher difficulty rooms now yield higher-tier chests

These chests contain increased Coin and Soul rewards

Adjusted layouts and balancing in some combat rooms


Farming
Added new visual effects when interacting with Crops and Farm Lands, especially when working with multiple tiles

Water Cans can now be refilled at water sources around the enviroment instead of only at the Water Hut


Controller
Adjusted aim assist on some weapons/projectiles


Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where Shop sell prices did not update correctly when stacking, splitting, or dropping items

Fixed a visual issue where Tool and Weapon durability bars reset to full length when closing the inventory

Durability bars now display correctly whenever the Main Inventory is opened

Fixed a stacking audio issue when using high-tier Water Cans or Hoes on Crops and Farm Lands

Fixed an issue where weapon damage values displayed extra decimal points in the description panel

Fixed an issue where certain weapon idle animations stopped when durability reached 0

Fixed an issue where the Weapon Research Menu could remain active and not close after crafting

Fixed an issue where the Next Level teleporter could be interacted with when no subsequent level existed

Fixed an issue where weapons appeared upside down when the player faced left while using a controller

Fixed an issue that could cause the player to become stuck in an open menu



Thank you for continuing to play. Every patch is a step toward a smoother and more enjoyable experience. Enjoy the new changes, and happy adventuring!

notes.title: Demo Update 0.2
notes.content:
Howdy everyone!

It’s been some time since the last update. This one brings improvements to Aboveground exploration, full controller support, enviromental changes, and some quality-of-life changes, adjustments, and fixes. Here’s what’s new:


Aboveground Update
Added a new Village enviornment with additional resource spawn points

The Rogue NPC is now a permanent resident of the Village with his own dedicated shop

Added day/night cycles

Depending on the time of the day, player, object, and the enviorment will have visual changes

Added additional music tracks to Aboveground


Controller Support
The game now supports controllers without a keyboard and mouse

Interactable objects will be automatically targeted when the player is nearby. If multiple interactable objects are within range, the closest object will be prioritized

While using weapons in combat, the attack direction will automatically target the nearest enemy to the player. This auto-aim feature can be overriden at anytime using the right joystick


Quality of Life
Higher tier Water Cans and Hoes can now affect a larger area of farmland

Water Can and Hoe descriptions are updated to reflect the area they can affect

Add a Quick Stack and a Move All option to Storage Chests

Quick Stack: Move all matching items in the Inventory to the opened Storage Chest

Move All: Move all items in the Inventory to the Storage Chest. Matching items will be moved first

Items picked up by the mouse will be automatically dropped when the inventory is closed

Updated Crop growth logic. Crops now can grop passively when the game is closed


Adjustments
Increased building placing speed

Building should be placable when the input is held down rather than needing to repeatedly hit the place button

Slightly increased Crop growth time

Updated Tool descriptions to reflect their rarity

Updated item stack count to 999

Adjusted some environmental objects to allow buildings to be placeable on the upper tile of a Tree

Adjusted the materials required to unlock the waystone in Grassland


Other
Added an option to delete save file and backup files

Added a report option when the options menu is opened

This option will required mouse & keyboard


Fixes
Fixed an issue that causes keybind to resets to "Any Key" when an going rebind operation is cancelled

Fixed cancel key and existing keybind conflicting issue when rebinding keys

Fixed sometimes keybinds cannot be be saved

Fixed an issue that caused weapon slot unable to be selected in some cases

Fixed save files can sometimes be overriden with an empty save file

Fixed some resources (such as Trees and Ores) can spawn on top of Berries

Fixed an issue that allowed Buildings to be placed as soon as it's selected on the Building Menu



Thank you for playing and supporting the game!

Feedback is always appreciated and helps guide future improvements.

notes.title: Demo Update 0.1
notes.content:
Aboveground Update

 Breakable Objects (Trees, Ores, Berries, etc.) now have independent spawn caps, increasing overall spawn rates
 Coal and Berry spawn rates are further increased to meet early-game stamina and smelting needs
 Stone now spawns in Grassland to speed up early progression
 Added animal encounters: 2 animals added in Grassland, 1 in Mountain
 Added new fishing rewards


Dungeon Update

 Added an introduction helper to Dungeon
 Added 5 new weapons and a multi-weapon system exclusive to dungeons
 Added 7 new enemies with new behaviors and projectile patterns
 Added 4 new utility buffs (selectable at the end of a dungeon stage)
 Added Healing Pot (heal to full health) and Research Table (dungeon weapon crafting) in Chamber 1-1
 Added more weapons to treasure chests
 Updated dungeon combat room structures with further improvements in higher stage rooms
 Updated old enemy behaviors to include more projectile patterns
 Increased enemy density in higher stages
 Increased Soul drops
 Rebalanced enemy stats
 Rebalanced dungeon room difficulty
 Improved Titan Guard boss behaviors
 Adjusted buff selection at the end of each dungeon stage. Stat Buffs are removed, they will be exclusive to enemy drops or shop purchases to increase the number of Utility Buffs the player can receive
 Destructible Objects (barrels, bookshelves, etc.) now drop items
 Shop Rooms now includes a reroll option for item choices


Save System Update

 Added a manual save button under Options -> Gameplay (in Aboveground)
 Added a backup system that will automatically create a backup folder that saves up to 10 backups whenever the game exits or upon a manual save
 To prevent any save file issues (in case it happens), it is recommended to backing up your progress. To create backups manually with an older version, you can do this by creating a copy of your save file located here: C:\Users\[YourName]\AppData\LocalLow\Chambers _ Crops\Chambers _ Crops\SaveFile
 If a save file is corrupted or lost, you can choose to load up a backup save through the "Backups" button in the main menu. The backup will automatically override the current save file


Progression Update

 Buildings, Tools, and Weapons will be unlockable via progression
 Note: most items are unlocked by default in the demo


Other Adjustment

 Added coin cost to Nightmire & Emberite Tools
 Increased (majority) item selling price
 Reduced Mineral requirements for smelting Ingots
 Reduced Stone Mineral required to craft Stone Tools
 Reduced cooldown and increased invulnerability duration to player dodge (including Perfect Dodge)
 Dodge now check for potential damage instances instead of if the player has been damaged during the initial dodge grace period
 Melee weapons now break projectiles by default
 New visual effects added for Thresher Blades, Broadswords, and dungeon melee weapons


Steam Achievement

 Added 14 basic Steam Achievements


Issue Fix

 Fixed item loading errors in Aboveground when items are left on the ground
 Fixed some items not being picked up when inventory slots were partially occupied
 Fixed items continuing to move toward the player after death
 Fixed Storage Chests incorrectly dropping stored items upon destruction
 Fixed progression data failing to load when player data had errors
 Fixed melee weapons sending incorrect damage source to enemies
 Fixed Destructible Objects (barrels, bookshelves, etc.) being destroyed multiple times per instance, causing excessive debris
 Fixed dungeon weapons not being removed correctly upon exiting the dungeon
 Fixed player buffs not being removed upon exiting the dungeon in certain scenarios
 Fixed Titan Guard boss being killable multiple times in one encounter
 Fixed Titan Guard boss getting stuck when losing its target during retreat
 Fixed Titan Guard boss being immune to damage or stuck in an invisible state when frozen
 Balanced Titan Guard boss damage intake to match other enemies
 Fixed errors when Titan Guard boss is knocked back when its target is lost
 Fixed enemies becoming invisible when frozen
 Fixed enemies often get stuck when moving near obstacles
 Fixed enemies being pushed outside dungeon rooms and becoming stuck
 Fixed UZI recoil animation stacking, causing the weapon to misalign


Future Update
The current progression in Aboveground feels limited and repetitive, once a few tools are unlocked, there's pretty much nothing else to do. To address this, progression in Aboveground is being expanded. Here’s a general overview of the plan:

Biome Overview

 Grassland: Basic materials to kickstart progression
 Village: Social hub with NPCs, shops, and quests
 Forest: More advanced wood materials, enemies, and environmental hazards
 Mountain: Entry point for advanced crafting and building, limited Ores (Coal, Iron, rare Gold), and as an entrance to the Cave
 Desert: Unique desert materials (cactus, bones as examples) plus enemies,structures, and events
 Cave: Accessible through Mountain after certain quests. Features advanced Ores, deep procedural levels, andheavier combat mechanics

Skill Update

 Combat skills will remain limited with some small adjustments if necessary while the other three (Farming, Fishing, Mining) will see expanded options such as tool enancements, new item unlocks, and additional mechanics
